about.title: About Me
about.bio: I am a Software Developer with professional experience in Frontend Development (React, JavaScript/TypeScript, Next.js, HTML5, CSS3 and Material UI). Skilled in designing responsive, accessible and high-performance interfaces, integrating APIs and collaborating in Agile teams while applying UI/UX best practices.

education.title: Education
education.degree: B.S. in Computer Science and Technology @ ITESM (2021-2025)

bullets: Developed responsive UI components and frontend features for a logistics SaaS company's web platforms (otif.mx and sgl.otif.mx) using React, TypeScript, Next.js and Material UI, working in Agile sprints alongside backend developers and UI/UX designers.

Built an end-to-end OTIF Careers platform covering the public job application flow with AI-powered resume autofill, HR management of job openings, candidates, application statuses and interview scheduling with calendar views, and an interviewer portal to review candidates, take notes and submit evaluations.

Collaborated on the redesign of vendor and customer management in SGL, Super Grid Logistics' internal platform used by 120+ employees to manage 15,000+ vendors, 90+ customers, 11,000+ quotes and 1,300+ shipments, and shipped new features such as route demand, biddings and a Vendor/Customer Intelligence module.
Enhanced UI/UX in otif.mx with AI-powered dashboards summarizing user tasks and priorities, real-time text streaming in Smart Documents chats, floating action buttons and i18n translations.
Resolved frontend bugs and implemented improvements based on user feedback, participated in code reviews and documented reusable UI components in Storybook.
